purpose: Selected immutable-list after evidence for optimize-admission-core-selection-index. It never overwrites the read-only before artifacts and reruns only the selected shipping implementation.

profile.profiledWorkload: 1024-task independent graph at 16 immutable transitions; 16 catalog and 16 Scheduler-candidate batches on the selected immutable@5.1.9 List implementation
profile.scalingBoundary: 4096-task independent rows use D=0 only; high-fanout forced-block rows intentionally stop at T=256 (B=255) because current closure is the path under investigation. The attempted current-runtime T=4096,D=48 catalog/candidate cross-product exceeded the bounded measurement window before completion; the 64/256 rows retain D=0/16/48 and 1024 retains D=0/16.

measurement.wall: performance.now() elapsed milliseconds for one batch; p50/p95 are quantiles over measured batches.
measurement.cpu: process.cpuUsage() delta per batch, recorded as user/system milliseconds.
measurement.heap: process.memoryUsage().heapUsed delta around a batch without forced GC; a live-heap proxy, not allocation or retained-size evidence.
measurement.cpuProfile: Bun --cpu-prof-md sampling profile of the named representative current-runtime workload; percentages identify sampled CPU time, not deterministic attribution.

beforeArtifacts.status: read-only; selected execution writes current-admission-core-immutable-list-* artifacts

selectedImplementation.reverseIndexesAndCounters: native frozen arrays, Map, Set, and immutable dense counter stores

comparisonScope.historicalCandidates: parent-delta, chunked-cow and full-clone artifacts are formation evidence only; no candidate path remains runnable

heapProfileObservation.rawArtifacts: intentionally not retained; each Bun --heap-prof-md output is a process-wide snapshot with no admission-state attribution

historicChunkedCow.topHierarchy: GlobalObject, ModuleLoader and ModuleRecord/module runtime dominated the retained hierarchy

selectedImmutableList.topHierarchy: GlobalObject, ModuleLoader and ModuleRecord/module runtime dominated the retained hierarchy

heapProfileObservation.boundary: These totals are process-level observations only; they are not allocation, branch-retention, selection-index, or catalog-DTO measurements.
